dvids.title: George H.W. Bush Carrier Strike Group Arrives in Thailand
dvids.desc: PHUKET, Thailand –Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George H.W. Bush (CVN 77), flagship of Carrier Strike Group (CSG) 10, and Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Delbert D. Black (DDG 119) arrived in Phuket for a scheduled port visit, Oct. 4, 2026.
